# PDF.js

Version: 6.4.299 (Mozilla release, 2026-10-03).

Source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/releases/tag/v6.4.299

Distribution: https://registry.npmjs.org/pdfjs-dist/-/pdfjs-dist-6.4.299.tgz

The legacy ES module, worker, character maps, fallback fonts, color profile, and decoder support files are served locally. No external PDF viewer service is used. Upstream license notices are retained in this folder and its asset subfolders.
